items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: Johnny Lindsay, Joe Lindsay. Now, Johnny Lindsay used to play trombone. ... And Joe Lindsay used to play drum.

ctx.x: What about Johnny Lindsay? Where was he from?
Johnny Lindsay from uptown. Johnny Lindsay, Joe Lindsay. Now, Johnny Lindsay used to play trombone. You sure know him all right. You keep up with him better than me.
Is he uptown or across the river? Where did he come from?
